invoices.title: Invoices with per-item tax
invoices.desc: Each line carries its own quantity, unit price and tax rate. The discount can be a fixed amount or a percentage, and the total always closes.

recurring.title: Recurring billing
recurring.desc: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly subscriptions. The app shows the next issue date and keeps the history of invoices already generated.

expenses.title: Expenses and receipts
expenses.desc: Log the outflow, pick a category, flag it as deductible and attach the receipt. Closing the month stops depending on memory.

reports.title: Reports your accountant understands
reports.desc: Revenue by period, by client and by service, expenses by category and a simplified income statement for the chosen range.

taxes.title: Estimated taxes
taxes.desc: Add up what was charged on the items plus the provision on the period's revenue — no surprises on tax day.

reconciliation.title: Payment reconciliation
reconciliation.desc: Register PIX, bank transfer, card or bank slip. A partial payment keeps the invoice open and shows exactly what is left.

pricing.title: Pick by invoice volume, not by the size of the promise
pricing.subtitle: Switch plans whenever you like — billing is prorated.
pricing.yearlyNote: Two months free on the yearly plan
pricing.guarantee: No lock-in, no cancellation fee and a full export of your data.

nfe.q: Does Conta Certa issue the official tax invoice?
nfe.a: The invoice organises the charge and the payment. The official service invoice is still issued on your city portal, and you attach the number to the document.

migrate.q: Can I bring my clients over from a spreadsheet?
migrate.a: Yes. The importer accepts CSV with name, legal name, tax ID, email and default payment term.

cancel.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
cancel.a: You can. There is no lock-in or penalty, and you take every record with you in CSV and PDF.

accountant.a: On the Business plan you add the accountant as a read-only user. On the others, send the period report in one click.

security.a: Everything travels encrypted, with daily backups and a log of who changed each document.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: It is 14 days with every Pro feature, no credit card. At the end you pick a plan or export the data.

about.title: Born out of a month-end that never closed
about.subtitle: We are a small team of product, accounting and support people obsessed with numbers that add up.
about.story1: In 2019 we served twenty clients with a shared spreadsheet and an invoice template in a word processor. Every month someone found a forgotten charge, a discount applied twice or a tax on the wrong line.
about.story2: Conta Certa started as the internal tool that fixed it: a single source for item, tax, discount and payment. When the third client asked for access, it became a product.
